verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both share the same flaws. In each, the Shop Flavours CTA is jammed right beside the subtitle with a tight gutter and sits on top of the decorative circle, and the legal line is too small to read. A spaces its rows more evenly. In B, the GLACIER wordmark is pushed close to the top edge, which leaves an uneven gap between the logo and the headline compared with the rest of the stack.
